mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_likes (comment_id, user_id, like_type, created_at) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{likeType}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE like_type = #{likeType}, created_at = #{createdAt}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comment_likes WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, comment_id as commentId, user_id as userId, like_type as likeType, created_at as createdAt FROM comment_likes WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT #{commentId} as targetId, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN like_type = 'LIKE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as likeCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN like_type = 'DISLIKE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as dislikeCount, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = #{userId} THEN like_type ELSE NULL END), NULL) as userLikeType, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as hasUserLiked FROM comment_likes WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND like_type = 'LIKE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND like_type = 'DISLIKE'
